d: A golf-inspired motorcycle presents a fresh design challenge for the Orange County Choppers team. Paul Jr. and the fabricators work to bring the theme to life while Paul Teutul Sr. and the crew add their familiar mix of opinions, arguments, and shop-floor humor. This episode of American Chopper combines custom fabrication with the family dynamics that make the series distinctive. For viewers who love custom bike shows, chopper motorcycle shows, motorcycle building shows, and custom motorcycle builders at work, this is another look inside the OCC garage.
